error[ZC-E0821]: the operating system's secure random source failed
  cause  the operating system's secure random source failed (EntropyUnavailable)
  fix    Check that the kernel's getrandom works here: the seccomp profile and the container sandbox must allow it.
  more   zcube explain E0821 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0821.html
